sectionDescription: Helpful tools and resources for international students to plan their education financing.

resources.title: EduPASS Cost Calculator
resources.description: Estimate your total cost of education at U.S. universities including tuition, living expenses, and more.

resources.title: IIE Funding for U.S. Study
resources.description: Institute of International Education's comprehensive database of scholarships for international students.

resources.title: InternationalScholarships.com
resources.description: Searchable database of scholarships, grants, and financial aid for international students worldwide.

resources.title: XE Currency Converter
resources.description: Convert between currencies to understand costs in your home currency. Live exchange rates updated constantly.

resources.title: Fulbright Program
resources.description: Prestigious U.S. government-sponsored scholarships for international students and scholars.

resources.title: EducationUSA
resources.description: U.S. Department of State's official resource for international students planning to study in the United States.

resources.title: Numbeo Cost of Living
resources.description: Compare cost of living between cities worldwide to plan your budget for studying abroad.

resources.title: Rotary Peace Fellowships
resources.description: Fully funded scholarships for peace and development studies at partner universities worldwide.

resources.title: USCIS Affidavit of Support (I-864)
resources.description: Official U.S. government guide on financial sponsorship requirements and the Affidavit of Support form.

resources.title: U.S. Visa Financial Evidence
resources.description: State Department guidelines on proving financial ability to support your studies for F-1 student visas.

resources.title: USCIS Declaration of Support (I-134)
resources.description: Information about the I-134 form used to show a sponsor's financial commitment for student visa applicants.

resources.title: University of Arkansas International Students
resources.description: Financial documentation and sponsorship requirements for international students at the University of Arkansas.

resources.title: UA Little Rock International Admissions
resources.description: Financial requirements and sponsorship information for international students at UA Little Rock.

resources.title: Study in the States
resources.description: Official DHS resource explaining financial requirements and documentation for international students.
